title: Why Some Volcanoes Explode and Others Flow
description: How magma forms and why gas decides whether a volcano flows or explodes, from USGS and NASA.
narration: Why does one volcano pour out lava while another blows itself apart? Deep underground, some rock melts into a thick liquid called magma. Magma is lighter than the surrounding rock, so it rises and collects in chambers. When it pushes out through a vent to the surface, it is called lava. How explosive an eruption is depends on the magma's composition. Thin, runny magma lets gas escape easily, so it flows out of the volcano. Thick, sticky magma traps gas until the pressure builds and the volcano explodes. Earth has both explosive volcanoes and ones with slow rivers of lava.

claims.sentence: Deep underground, some rock melts into a thick liquid called magma.
claims.quote: Deep within the Earth it is so hot that some rocks slowly melt and become a thick flowing substance called magma.

claims.sentence: Magma is lighter than the surrounding rock, so it rises and collects in chambers.
claims.quote: Since it is lighter than the solid rock around it, magma rises and collects in magma chambers.

claims.sentence: When it pushes out through a vent to the surface, it is called lava.
claims.quote: Eventually, some of the magma pushes through vents and fissures to the Earth's surface. Magma that has erupted is called lava.

claims.sentence: How explosive an eruption is depends on the magma's composition.
claims.quote: The explosivity of an eruption depends on the composition of the magma.

claims.sentence: Thin, runny magma lets gas escape easily, so it flows out of the volcano.
claims.quote: If magma is thin and runny, gases can escape easily from it. When this type of magma erupts, it flows out of the volcano.

claims.sentence: Thick, sticky magma traps gas until the pressure builds and the volcano explodes.
claims.quote: If magma is thick and sticky, gases cannot escape easily. Pressure builds up until the gases escape violently and explode.

claims.sentence: Earth has both explosive volcanoes and ones with slow rivers of lava.
claims.quote: volcanoes that explode with ash and gas, and volcanoes that have slow rivers of melted rock (known as lava).
